# docker_buildx_builder (Data Source)

Reads one buildx builder, like `docker buildx inspect`: driver, nodes with endpoint, status, buildkitd flags, driver options, BuildKit version, platforms, worker labels and GC policy. The provider talks to BuildKit itself (the daemon's `/grpc` endpoint, or `buildctl dial-stdio` in a node container); it never runs buildx and does not read buildx's client-side builder store, so only builders on the provider's daemon are found, and `last_activity` is the newest node container's creation time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The daemon's own BuildKit (buildx's "default" builder).
data "docker_buildx_builder" "default" {}

# A docker-container builder, e.g. one made by docker_buildx_builder.
data "docker_buildx_builder" "ci" {
  name = "ci"
}

output "ci_buildkit" {
  value = {
    version   = data.docker_buildx_builder.ci.buildkit_version
    platforms = data.docker_buildx_builder.ci.platforms
    status    = [for n in data.docker_buildx_builder.ci.builder.nodes : "${n.name}: ${n.status}"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Builder to inspect, as for `docker buildx inspect <name>`. Default `default`, the daemon's built-in BuildKit (buildx's `docker` driver); any other name is a docker-container builder whose node containers `buildx_buildkit_<name><n>` run on the provider's daemon.

### Read-Only

- `builder` (Attributes) The builder object field by field (name, driver, last activity, nodes with endpoint, status, BuildKit version, platforms, labels, GC policy). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--builder))
- `buildkit_version` (String) BuildKit daemon version of the first node (identity, not one of the six version names; see naming_questions).
- `buildx_version` (String) The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of inspect_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon (GET /version Version).
- `driver` (String) Builder driver: `docker` for the daemon's builder, `docker-container` otherwise.
- `endpoint` (String) Endpoint of the first node: `default`, or `docker-container://buildx_buildkit_<node>`.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon for this read/apply.
- `id` (String) Builder id (the builder name).
- `inspect_json` (String, Sensitive) The builder and its nodes as one JSON document (the `docker buildx inspect` view, keys as in `buildx ls --format json` Builder object). Sensitive: driver options carry env.* values.
- `labels` (Map of String) BuildKit worker labels of the first node (`org.mobyproject.buildkit.worker.*`).
- `platforms` (List of String) Platforms the builder can build for, the union over its nodes (empty for nodes that are not running).
